y-m-60-08.title: Chirongwa chipi pamaviri chekuchengeta mari chinotanga kuhwina?
y-m-60-08.topic: Kuenzanisa kukura kwe arithmetic ne geometric sequences: sarudzo inochinja nenguva
y-m-60-08.goal: Enzanisa chirongwa chinokura nehuwandu hwakagadzikana gore rimwe nerimwe nechinokura nerate yakagadzikana, dzidza kuti ndechipi chiri nani chinoenderana nenguva, uye upe zano kuvanhu vari mumamiriro akasiyana uchitaura fungidziro dzako.
y-m-60-08.material: Pane zvirongwa zviviri zvekuchengeta mari zvinotanga zvese ne 100만 원. Chirongwa A chinokura ne 10만 원 pakupera kwegore rimwe nerimwe. Chirongwa B chinokura ne 5% yehuwandu hwegore rapfuura pakupera kwegore rimwe nerimwe (huwandu mushure memakore n i 100 × 1.05ⁿ 만 원). Usafunga mutero, mitengo, kana kubvisa nekukurumidza. n i huwandu hwemakore apfuura. (Maitiro ekuverenga: 1.05ⁿ i '1.05 to the n-th power'.)

y-m-60-08.thinking.2: Nyora zano rine mamiriro rinokodzera munhu

y-m-60-08.s.s1.r.a: Verenga huwandu mushure megore 1 namakore 2 kuhurongwa hwose mbiri uye utange watarisa kuti upi uri mberi.
y-m-60-08.s.s1.o.b: Zvakafanana. Mushure memakore 10, huwandu hwehurongwa hwaviri hwakanyatsoenzana
y-m-60-08.s.s1.r.b: Verenga huwandu mushure memakore 10 imwe neimwe uye uenzanise. Shandisa kashandisi kuverenga kutsvaga kuti 100 × 1.05¹⁰ ndi ani.
y-m-60-08.s.s1.o.c: A ine yakawanda. Parizvino, hurongwa hunokura nehuwandu hwakagadzikana gore rega rega huri mberi
y-m-60-08.s.s1.o.d: Hapana ruzivo rwakakwana. Kunyange huwandu hwekutanga hwakafanana, tinoda kuziva zvakawanda
y-m-60-08.s.s1.r.d: Ruzivo rwose rwunodikanwa rwatopiwa. Isa mumafomula uye uverenge.
y-m-60-08.s.s1.explain: Mushure memakore 10, A ndi 100 + 10 × 10 = 200만 원 uye B ndi 100 × 1.05¹⁰ ≈ 162.9만 원, saka A ine yakawanda. Mushure megore 1 zvakare, A ndi 110 uye B ndi 105, saka A iri mberi. Hurongwa hunokura nereti haupo mberi kubva pakutanga.
y-m-60-08.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga uye uise makore matatu akasiyana n umo B ine mari yakawanda kupfuura A. (Mushure memakore n, A ndi 100 + 10n uye B ndi 100 × 1.05ⁿ 만 원. Unogona kushandisa kashandisi kuverenga.)

y-m-60-03.title: Madhijiti mangani ekufanofungidzira atinogona kuvimba nawo?
y-m-60-03.topic: Kufanofungidzira kwe common logarithms nehuwandu hwemadhijiti: tinogona kuvimba nekufanofungidzira kusvika kupi?
y-m-60-03.goal: Dzidza kuti kukanganisa kudiki mukufanofungidzira kunogona kuchinja mhedziso sezvo n ichikura, tsvaga nyaya apo mhedziso inosiyana, uye utaure mamiriro apo kufanofungidzira kunogona kuvimbwa.
y-m-60-03.material: Tinoda kutsvaga kuti 2ⁿ ine madhijiti mangani. Huwandu hwemadhijiti e positive integer N ndi (chikamu che integer che log N) + 1, saka huwandu hwemadhijiti e 2ⁿ ndi (chikamu che integer che n × log 2) + 1. Kukosha chaiko kwe log 2 ndi 0.30102999566…, asi Soyoung akashandisa kufanofungidzira 0.301 uye akawana huwandu hwemadhijiti nekuwedzera 1 kuchikamu che integer che n × 0.301. (Chikamu che integer ndiyo integer iri pamberi pe decimal point. Muenzaniso: chikamu che integer che 9.03 ndi9.)
y-m-60-03.thinking.1: Tsvaga iwe pachako nyaya apo mhedziso inosiyana
y-m-60-03.prereq.0: Hukama pakati pe common logarithms nehuwandu hwemadhijiti (huwandu hwemadhijiti e positive integer N ndi chikamu che integer che log N pamwe ne1)
y-m-60-03.prereq.1: Chokwadi chekuti kukosha kwe log 2 kunenge 0.301, nekushandisa calculator
y-m-60-03.prereq.2: Iyi nhanho yekuoma yebasa iri (H3), kwete kugoverwa kwegore rechikoro, uye inofungidzira kuti watopedza chikamu che common logarithms.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.prompt: Kune n=30, Soyoung akati 30 × 0.301 = 9.03, saka 2³⁰ inhamba ine madhijiti 10. Tinogona kuvimba nemhedziso iyi here? Wedzera 30 nekukosha chaiko 0.30102999566…, enzanisa, uye usarudze.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora padivi pemumwe kukosha kwe30 nguva kufanofungidzira nekukosha kwe30 nguva kukosha chaiko, kusvika kune decimal places mana.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa musiyano wemakosha maviri nemwero kubva pakukosha kwakaverengwa kuenda kuinteger iri padhuze.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.o.a: Sezvo kufanofungidzira kwakashandiswa pane kukanganisa, hatigoni kuziva huwandu hwemadhijiti kusvika taverenga nekukosha chaiko
y-m-60-03.s.s1.r.a: Kukosha chaiko kwatopiwa, saka kuenzanisa ma products maviri kunokuudza saizi yekukanganisa. Funga kana kukanganisa kuri kukuru zvakakwana kuchinja mhedziso.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.o.b: 9.03 iri kure neinteger 9 kupfuura kukanganisa (pasi pe0.001), saka mhedziso yemadhijiti 10 inoshanda
y-m-60-03.s.s1.o.c: Kufanofungidzira kuri pasi pekukosha chaiko, saka huwandu chaihwo hwemadhijiti hunogara huri hwakawanda neimwe kupfuura huwandu hwakawanikwa nekufanofungidzira
y-m-60-03.s.s1.r.c: Kukosha kudiki zvishoma hakuchinji zvakanga chikamu che integer. Funga kuti chii chaifanira kuitika kuti chikamu che integer chichinje.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.o.d: 0.301 nekukosha chaiko zvinobvumirana kusvika kune yechitatu decimal place, saka huwandu hwemadhijiti hwakafanana kune n ipi neipi
y-m-60-03.s.s1.r.d: Kukanganisa kunokura nguva n kana kwawedzerwa ne n. Enzanisa nyaya ye n=30 nenyaya apo n iri hombe zvikuru.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.explain: 30 × 0.30102999566… = 9.0309… uye 30 × 0.301 = 9.03, saka musiyano uri pasi pe0.001. Makosha ose maviri ari pakati pe9 ne10, saka chikamu che integer ndi9 munyaya mbiri dzose, uye 2³⁰ inhamba ine madhijiti 10 (2³⁰ = 1073741824). Kuti kufanofungidzira kunogona kuvimbwa here kunoenderana nesaizi yekukanganisa nekuti kukosha kwakaverengwa kuri kure zvakadii neinteger.
y-m-60-03.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga uye uise nhamba mbiri dzechisikigo dzakasiyana n apo huwandu hwemadhijiti e 2ⁿ hwakawanikwa nenzira yaSoyoung (uchishandisa 0.301) nekukosha chaiko (uchishandisa 0.30102999566…) dzakasiyana. (Huwandu hwemadhijiti = chikamu che integer che n × log 2 + 1)
y-m-60-03.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga kune n dzakawanda uye utsvage n apo chikamu che decimal che n × 0.301 chiri padhuze zvikuru ne1.
y-m-60-03.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga makosha mashoma kuti uone kuti musiyano pakati pe n×0.301 ne n×(kukosha chaiko) unochinja sei sezvo n ichikura.
y-m-60-03.s.s2.fail.c1: n inofanira kuva nhamba yechisikigo ine 1 kana kupfuura.
y-m-60-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Huwandu hwemadhijiti hwakawanikwa nenzira mbiri hwakasiyana.
y-m-60-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Huwandu hwemadhijiti hwakawanikwa nenzira mbiri hwakafanana. Enzanisa zvikamu ze integer ze n×0.301 ne n×0.30102999566.
y-m-60-03.s.s2.explain: Ne n=196, 196 × 0.301 = 58.996 ine chikamu che integer 58, saka inoti madhijiti 59, asi nekukosha chaiko, 196 × 0.30102999566… = 59.0018…, saka chikamu che integer ndi59 uye 2¹⁹⁶ inhamba ine madhijiti 60. Zvakafananawo kune n=299 (madhijiti 91) ne n=392 (madhijiti 119). Kana kukosha kwakaverengwa kuri pasi zvishoma peinteger, kukanganisa kudiki kunogona kuita kuti kupfuure kana kusapfuura integer, uye mhedziso inochinja.
y-m-60-03.s.s3.prompt: Kune n=30 taigona kuvimba nekufanofungidzira, asi kwete kune n yawakangowana. Mumutsara mumwe kana miviri, nyora kuti chii chinoparadzanisa nyaya apo huwandu hwemadhijiti hwakawanikwa nekufanofungidzira 0.301 hunogona kuvimbwa nenyaya apo husingagoni.
y-m-60-03.s.s3.hint.0: Kune n=30 ne n=196, nyora kuti n×0.301 iri kure zvakadii neinteger iri padhuze.
y-m-60-03.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa dhuri iroro ne n×(mutengo chaiwo − 0.301).
y-m-60-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakataura kuti kukanganisa kunokura ne n here?
y-m-60-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti i njodzi kana mutengo wakaverengwa uri pasi (kana pamusoro) chaipo peinteger here?
y-m-60-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakatarisa zvawakataura ne n yawakawana (semuenzaniso, 196) kana nekuverenga kwa n=30 here?
y-m-60-03.s.s3.model.0: Kukanganisa kwe approximation kunowanzwa ne n, saka painonyanya kukura n, ndipo painonyanya kukura kukanganisa. Saka kana n×0.301 iri padyo kwazvo neinteger, kukanganisa kunogona kuita kuti ipfuure kana kusapfuura integer uye kuchinja huwandu hwema digits, uye kana iri kure neinteger, unogona kuivimba.
y-m-60-03.s.s3.model.1: Kana mutengo wakaverengwa 9.03 uri kure neinteger, sa pa 30, chikamu che integer hachichinji kunyange nekukanganisa (anenge 0.001). Kana mutengo wakaverengwa i 58.996, uri padyo kwazvo ne integer 59, sa pa 196, musiyano mudiki unochinja huwandu hwema digits.
y-m-60-03.s.s3.modelNote.1: Hazvitaure kuti kukanganisa kunokura ne n, asi zvinowana poinzi huru nekuenzanisa dhuri kubva ku integer nekukanganisa.

y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Data iyi inochinja sei kutonga kwako?
y-m-60-05.title: Kutenderera kunodzokororwa kwemhando yegungwa: data rinogona kutiudza zvakadini?
y-m-60-05.topic: Period ye sine function: period inogona kusarudzwa kusvika kupi kubva pakuyera kwakaitwa pama interval akaenzana
y-m-60-05.goal: Dzidza kuti data rakayerwa pama interval makuru haringasarudze period, gadzirisa kutonga kwako painouya data rakawanda, uye uenzanise zvakananga ma models ema candidates nekuyera.
y-m-60-05.material: Tinoda kuyera kukwirira kwegungwa (m) pachiteshi uye kuritaura nechimiro che h(t) = 3 + 2·sin(2πt/T). t i nguva (mumaawa) kubva pa 0 o'clock, uye T i period (mumaawa). Kuyera kunotenderedzwa kuita mayuniti e 0.1 m uye kunogona kuchinja anenge ±0.2 m nekuda kwemafungu. Chinangwa i kusarudza T. (Maitiro ekuverenga: 2πt/T i '2π t over T'.)

y-m-60-05.thinking.2: Enzanisa ma models e candidates nekuyera

y-m-60-05.prereq.2: Iri i danho rekunetsa rebasa iri (H3), kwete kugoverwa kwegore rechikoro, uye rinofungidzira kuti wakadzidza ma graphs e trigonometric functions.

y-m-60-05.s.s1.reflect: Kuita maawa 12 se 'candidate inogona' pachinzvimbo che 'kusimbisa' pa data rekutanga kwakabatsira sei mudata rekupedzisira? Kune rimwe divi, dai wakasimbisa maawa 12, data ripi raizozunza pfungwa iyoyo?

y-m-60-05.s.s2.r.a: h(12)≈3.54 ne h(24)≈4.04. Dzakakwira zvikuru kupfuura mitengo yakayerwa.
y-m-60-05.s.s2.r.b: h(12)=3.0 ne h(24)=3.0. Dzakasiyana nekuyera 2.6 ne 2.2 ne 0.4 ne 0.8.
y-m-60-05.s.s2.r.d: h(12)≈2.07 ne h(24)≈1.35. Dziri pasi zvikuru kupfuura mitengo yakayerwa.

T=12 inopa 3.0 ne 3.0, T=13 inopa 2.07 ne 1.35, uye T=11.5 inopa 3.54 ne 4.04, saka hazvigone kutsanangura kuyera kuviri panguva imwechete. y-m-60-04.title: Kana sin θ i 3/5, cos θ inosarudzwa sechimwe here?
y-m-60-04.topic: Hukama pakati pema trigonometric functions: mamiriro apo cos θ ne tan θ zvinosarudzwa kana sin θ yapiwa
y-m-60-04.goal: Ratidza, nekuwana mitengo yese inogoneka, kuti mutengo we sine oga husingasarudze mitengo ye cosine ne tangent sechimwe, uye usarudze ruzivo rwekuwedzera runosimbisa mitengo.
y-m-60-04.material: Angle θ i general angle (hazvina basa kana i mu radians kana degrees) uye sin θ = 3/5. Harin akati, "Sezvo sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, cos θ = 4/5 uye tan θ = 3/4." (Maitiro ekuverenga: sin θ i 'sine theta', sin²θ i 'sine theta squared', uye 3/5 i 'three fifths'.)
y-m-60-04.prereq.0: Tsanangudzo ye trigonometric functions yema general angles nemasimbi awo mu quadrant imwe neimwe
y-m-60-04.prereq.2: Iri i danho rekunetsa rebasa iri (H3), kwete kugoverwa kwegore rechikoro, uye rinofungidzira kuti wapedza yuniti ye trigonometric functions.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.prompt: Kutonga kupi kwakakodzera zvikuru pamusoro pemhedziso yaHarin?
y-m-60-04.s.s1.hint.0: Wana mutengo we cos²θ, wobva waverenga kuti nhamba dzingani dzine mutengo iwoyo kana dzaitwa square.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora kuti ma quadrants api ane ma angles apo sin θ i positive.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.o.a: Yakarurama. Kubva ku sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, cos θ = 4/5 ne tan θ = 3/4 zvinosarudzwa
y-m-60-04.s.s1.r.a: Tarisa kana pane nhamba imwe chete ine square i 16/25.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.o.b: cos θ inobuda semitengo miviri, 4/5 ne −4/5, asi tsika i kutora positive square root, saka inosarudzwa se 4/5
y-m-60-04.s.s1.r.b: Tsika yekutora positive root i nezve chiratidzo che square root. Tarisa kana angle ine cos θ i negative ichigona kugutsa sin θ = 3/5.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.o.c: cos θ inogona kuva 4/5 kana −4/5, saka haisarudzwi semutengo mumwe kubva paruzivo rwakapiwa oga
y-m-60-04.s.s1.o.d: Kana sin θ = 3/5, saka θ inofanira kuva angle mu first quadrant, saka mutengo waHarin wakarurama
y-m-60-04.s.s1.r.d: Tarisa kana ma angles ane sin θ i positive aripo mu first quadrant chete.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.explain: Sezvo sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, cos²θ = 1 − 9/25 = 16/25, saka cos θ = 4/5 kana −4/5. Kana sin θ>0, θ i mu first kana second quadrant, saka zviitiko zvese zviviri zvinogoneka.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.prompt: Wana uye uise mapeya maviri akasiyana emitengo (cos θ, tan θ) inogoneka ye angle θ ne sin θ = 3/5. (Nyora ma fractions se ma decimals. Muenzaniso: 3/5 = 0.6)
y-m-60-04.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wawana cos²θ, wobva wawana mitengo yese ye cos θ inoipa.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.hint.1: Pa cos θ imwe neimwe, verenga sin θ ÷ cos θ kuwana tan θ.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Haisi sin²θ + cos²θ = 1. sin²θ i 0.36. Tarisa kuti square ye cos θ inofanira kuva chii.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Inogutsa tan θ = sin θ ÷ cos θ.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.fail.c2: tan θ × cos θ haienzani ne sin θ = 0.6. Wana tan θ zvakare.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.explain: Kana cos θ = 0.8, saka tan θ = 0.6 ÷ 0.8 = 0.75, uye kana cos θ = −0.8, saka tan θ = −0.75. Mbiri idzi ndidzo mikana yese.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.prompt: Tinoda kukumbira ruzivo rwekuwedzera kusarudza pakati pemikana miviri. Sarudza zvese zvezvinyorwa zvinotevera zvingasarudza (cos θ, tan θ) sechimwe kana kuwedzerwa ku sin θ = 3/5 kunyange kana chimwe chete chakapiwa.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.hint.0: Isa ma candidates maviri (0.8, 0.75) ne (−0.8, −0.75) mumamiriro esarudzo imwe neimwe.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.hint.1: Paradzanisa sarudzo dzinogutswa nema candidates ese maviri kubva kune dzinogutswa nerimwe chete.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.r.b: Pakati pe 0 ne π pane ma angles ari mu first ne second quadrants zvose. Tarisa kana ma candidates ese maviri anosara.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.o.c: Chokwadi chekuti cos θ + sin θ < 1
y-m-60-04.s.s3.o.d: Chokwadi chekuti θ i angle mu first kana second quadrant
y-m-60-04.s.s3.r.d: Kana sin θ>0, izvi zvinozivikanwa kare. Tarisa kana i ruzivo rutsva.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.r.e: Mune ma candidates ese maviri, cos θ haisi 0. Tarisa kana ingavasiyanisa.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.o.f: Chokwadi chekuti sin θ × cos θ > 0
y-m-60-04.s.s3.explain: Ma candidates i (0.8, 0.75) ne (−0.8, −0.75). a: tan θ<0 inogutswa neyechipiri chete. c: cos θ + sin θ i 1.4 kuyekutanga uye −0.2 kuyechipiri, saka <1 inogutswa neyechipiri chete. f: sin θ × cos θ>0 zvinoreva cos θ>0, saka yekutanga chete inogutsa. b, d, ne e zvinogutswa ne ma candidates ese maviri, saka hazvigone kuvasiyanisa.

y-m-60-02.title: Exponent hombe inogara ichipa kukosha kukuru here?
y-m-60-02.topic: Kuenzanisa exponents: nyaya apo nzira ye inequality inoenderana ne base
y-m-60-02.goal: Dzidza kuti 'mienzaniso yose yandakatarisa inoshanda' haikwani seumboo hwechirevo chakajairika, gadzira iwe pachako muenzaniso unopikisa, uye usarudze mamiriro anodiwa kusvika kumhedziso.
y-m-60-02.material: Minji akati, "a ndi positive uye a≠1. Saka kana aᵐ < aⁿ, saka m < n." (m ne n ndema real numbers. Nzira yekuverenga: aᵐ ndi 'a to the m-th power'.) Minji akatarisa kuti ne a=2, 2¹ < 2³, uye ne a=3, 3² < 3⁵, uye munyaya mbiri dzose m<n.
y-m-60-02.thinking.0: Tonga kuti mienzaniso inomiririra zvakadii (marenji api e base akaedzwa)
y-m-60-02.prereq.0: Powers nemitemo ye exponents (kusanganisira negative ne zero exponents)
y-m-60-02.prereq.2: Iyi nhanho yekuoma yebasa iri (H3), kwete kugoverwa kwegore rechikoro, uye inofungidzira kuti watopedza chikamu che exponents ne logarithms.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.prompt: Zvichienderana nemienzaniso miviri yakatariswa naMinji, chirevo chipi nezve chirevo chaMinji chinonyanya kukodzera?
y-m-60-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa kuti makosha akaedzwa naMinji akaungana pakati perenji rinogoneka re a.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza a imwe kubva kurenji risina kuedzwa uye uverenge chaizvo aᵐ ne aⁿ.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.o.a: Yakashanda kaviri, ne2 ne3, saka tinogona kutaura kuti chirevo chinoshanda kune a dzose
y-m-60-02.s.s1.r.a: Kushanda kaviri hakusi umboo. Tanga wafunga kuti ma base akaedzwa anobva murenji renhamba ripi.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.o.b: Hatigoni kuva nechokwadi kusvika tayedza zvakaparadzana nyaya apo m ne n dziri real numbers dzisiri integers
y-m-60-02.s.s1.r.b: Dambudziko ndere renji re base a kwete renji re m ne n. Tarisazve makosha e a akaedzwa.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.o.c: Ma base akaedzwa ose akakura kupfuura 1, saka tinogona kuva nechokwadi kana tayedza ma base ari pasi pe1 zvakare
y-m-60-02.s.s1.o.d: Mienzaniso inoshanda haiputsi chirevo, saka kana pasina muenzaniso unopikisa waonekwa, tinogona kuchigamuchira seyechokwadi
y-m-60-02.s.s1.r.d: Kusambotsvaga muenzaniso unopikisa kwakasiyana nekusava nemuenzaniso unopikisa. Ona kuti makosha e a api asati aedzwa.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.explain: Ma base akaedzwa 2 ne3 zvose akakura kupfuura 1. Sezvo a ingavawo 0<a<1, hatigoni kutaura 'inogara' tisati taedza nyaya iyoyo. Renji rinomiririrwa nemienzaniso yakatariswa rinotara simba reumboo.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira uye uise (a, m, n) mbiri ne ma base a akasiyana kuti aᵐ < aⁿ asi m>n. (a ndi nhamba yakakura kupfuura 0 uye isiri 1. Unogona kuinyora se decimal.)
y-m-60-02.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza a kuva nhamba iri pasi pe1, uye uverenge makosha mashoma kuti uone kuti aᵐ inochinja sei sezvo m ichikura.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza ma integers mashoma e m ne n, uverenge a^m ne a^n, wozoenzanisa saizi dzazvo.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.fail.c1: a inofanira kuva positive uye isiri 1.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.fail.c2: m haina kukura kupfuura n. Sarudza nhamba mbiri ne m>n.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.fail.c3: aᵐ haisi pasi pe aⁿ. Verenga chaizvo makosha ose maviri uye uaenzanise.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, ne a=0.5, m=3, n=1, tinowana 0.5³=0.125 < 0.5¹=0.5 kunyange m>n. Ne a=0.25, m=2, n=−1, tinowana 0.0625 < 4. Chirevo chaMinji hachishande kune 0<a<1.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.prompt: Kubva pachokwadi chekuti aᵐ < aⁿ, chii chimwe chaunoda kuziva, pamusoro pemamiriro ari pamusoro (a ndi positive, a≠1), kuti ugone kupedzisa m < n? Sarudza zvose zvinokwana. (Unogona kuziva nekugadzira mienzaniso inopikisa nekuiedza.)
y-m-60-02.s.s3.hint.0: Kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, tsvaga (a, m, n) inogutsa mamiriro ayo asi ichiri muenzaniso unopikisa.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.hint.1: Kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, tarisa kana renji re a rinosara rine nhamba dziri pasi pe1.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.o.a: Chokwadi chekuti a ndi natural number
y-m-60-02.s.s3.r.a: Kana a ndi natural number isiri 1, funga kuti a inotangira kupi. Nyora kukosha kudiki kunogoneka.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.o.b: Chokwadi chekuti m ne n zvose ndema positive
y-m-60-02.s.s3.r.b: a=0.5, m=3, n=1 ine m ne n zvose positive, asi aᵐ<aⁿ nepo m>n.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.r.c: Ne a=0.7, m=3, n=1, tinowana 0.343<0.7 kunyange m>n.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.r.d: Kana a yakakura kupfuura 1, aˣ inongochinja nenzira inokwira, saka nzira ye inequality inochengetwa.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.r.e: Mamiriro atoziva kare, saka haasi ruzivo rutsva. Haasiyanisi a>1 ne 0<a<1.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.explain: Kana a>1, aˣ inokwira, saka aᵐ<aⁿ ⇒ m<n. Kana a ndi natural number isiri 1, saka a≥2, saka a>1, izvo zvinokwanawo. Kune b, c, ne e, makosha e a ane 0<a<1 anosara, saka muenzaniso unopikisa unogoneka. Neraki, dai 0<a<1 yaizikanwa, mhedziso yaizova m>n.

y-m-60-01.title: Mhinduro imwe chete here? Basa rakatadza papi?
y-m-60-01.topic: Zvimiro zve logarithms nemamiriro e argument: mhinduro dze log₂(x²)=4
y-m-60-01.goal: Dzidza kuti danho rinoshandisa chimiro che logarithm rinogona kuchinja renji rinobvumirwa re x, tsvaga mutsara apo mhinduro dzinonyangarika uye uigadzirise, uye usarudze madanho asingachinji renji.
y-m-60-01.material: Suho akagadzirisa equation log₂(x²) = 4 (x ndi real number isiri 0) sezvakaratidzwa pazasi. (Nzira yekuverenga: log₂ A ndi 'the logarithm of A with base 2', uye x² ndi 'x squared'.)
y-m-60-01.thinking.0: Tarisa kana mutsara mumwe nemumwe uchishanda pasi pemamiriro akafanana nemutsara uri pamberi payo
y-m-60-01.thinking.2: Enzanisa renji rinobvumirwa pamberi nepashure peshanduko
y-m-60-01.prereq.0: Tsananguro nezvimiro zve logarithms (argument inofanira kuva positive, uye log M^k = k·log M inoshandiswa kana M>0)
y-m-60-01.prereq.1: Hukama pakati penhamba dzine absolute value ne square zvakafanana
y-m-60-01.prereq.2: Iyi nhanho yekuoma yebasa iri (H3), kwete kugoverwa kwegore rechikoro, uye inofungidzira kuti watodzidza zvimiro ze exponents ne logarithms.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe mumhinduro yaSuho apo inotadza.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.hint.0: Enzanisa kana mutsara mumwe nemumwe uchishanda kurenji re x rimwe chete nemutsara uri pamberi payo.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.hint.1: Isa x imwe negative mu equation yekutanga uye utarise kana kukosha kwakatsanangurwa.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 2 ndiko kunotadza. log₂ x inogona kushandiswa chete kana x iri positive, asi equation yekutanga ichine zvainoreva kana x iri negative, nekuti x² iri positive. Mutsara 2 unosiya nyaya x<0, uye nekudaro chirevo che 'imwe chete' mumutsara 5 mhedziso yakashata. Mutsara 5 unogamuchirwawo semutsara wakashata. Kunyangwe x = −4 inopa log₂ 16 = 4.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga uye uise ma real numbers maviri akasiyana x anogutsa equation yekutanga log₂(x²) = 4.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.hint.0: Uchishandisa tsananguro ye logarithm, nyora zvakare log₂ A = 4 sehukama pakati pe A ne2.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.hint.1: Isa x yawakawana mu log₂(x²) yekutanga uye utarise kuti unowana 4.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Kana x=0, saka x²=0, saka argument ye logarithm haisi positive.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Kukosha kwe log₂(x²) hakusi 4. Funga zvakare kuti power ipi ye2 inopa x².
y-m-60-01.s.s2.explain: Netsananguro ye logarithm, x² = 2⁴ = 16, saka x = 4 kana x = −4. Makosha ose maviri anogutsa equation yekutanga, saka pane mhinduro mbiri.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.prompt: Shanduko senge mutsara 2 waSuho inogona kuchinja renji rinobvumirwa re x. Sarudza shanduko dzose dziri pazasi apo 'renji remakosha anogona kutorwa ne x rakafanana pamberi nepashure'. (x ndi real number.)
y-m-60-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kune divi rekuruboshwe nerekurudyi resarudzo imwe neimwe, nyora zvakaparadzana 'x inofanira kuva murenji ripi kuti kukosha mukati me logarithm kuve positive', uye uenzanise.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kune sarudzo dzine marenji anoratidzika akasiyana, isa x imwe negative kumativi ose maviri.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.r.a: Divi rekurudyi rine zvainoreva kana x>0 chete, nepo divi rekuruboshwe richida x≠0 chete. Isa x=−4 kumativi ose maviri.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.r.b: Enzanisa kana mamiriro ekuti x/3 ive positive akafanana nemamiriro ekuti x ive positive.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.r.c: Divi rekuruboshwe rinewo zvainoreva kune x<0 kana x>2. Funga kuti divi rekurudyi rine zvainoreva murenji ripi.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.r.d: Divi rekuruboshwe rine zvainoreva kana x>0 chete, nepo divi rekurudyi riine zvainoreva kunyange kana x iri negative. Renji rakafara.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.r.e: Mamiriro ekuti |x| ive positive akafanana ne x≠0. Tarisa kana x negative yakasanganisirwa.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.explain: Kune b, x/3>0 ⇔ x>0, saka renji rakafanana, uye kune e, |x|>0 ⇔ x≠0, saka renji rakafanana. Mu a, x<0 inonyangarika; mu c, divi re x<0 rinonyangarika; uye mu d, renji rinofara nenzira yakapesana. Shanduko inochinja renji inogona kukuita urasikirwe kana kuwana mhinduro, saka mushure mekushandura unofanira kuisa mu equation yekutanga kutarisa.

y-m-60-07.title: Kutarisa mhinduro inowana general term kubva pa formula yehuwandu
y-m-60-07.topic: Huwandu hwe sequence nema general term ayo: kutarisa term yekutanga kana uchiwana aₙ kubva ku Sₙ
y-m-60-07.goal: Mumhinduro inowana general term kubva pahuwandu Sₙ, wana kwashaikwa fungidziro n≥2, utarise nenhamba chaidzo, uye ugadzire iwe pachako formula yehuwandu isingade kuti term yekutanga isimbiswe zvakaparadzana.
y-m-60-07.material: Pa sequence {aₙ}, huwandu hwe term yekutanga kusvika ku n-th term i Sₙ = n² + 2n + 3 (n i natural number), uye Eunwoo akawana general term sezvinoratidzwa pazasi. (Maitiro ekuverenga: aₙ i 'n-th term', Sₙ i 'huwandu kubva pa term yekutanga kusvika ku n-th term', uye Sₙ₋₁ i 'huwandu kusvika ku (n−1)-th term'.)
y-m-60-07.thinking.2: Gadzira iwe pachako formula inogutsa mamiriro
y-m-60-07.prereq.0: Hukama pakati pehuwandu Sₙ ne general term aₙ ye sequence (Sₙ i huwandu kubva pa term yekutanga kusvika ku n-th term)
y-m-60-07.prereq.2: Iri i danho rekunetsa rebasa iri (H3), kwete kugoverwa kwegore rechikoro, uye rinofungidzira kuti wapedza yuniti ye sequences.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe mumhinduro yaEunwoo apo unokanganisa.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.hint.0: Enzanisa zvakananga mhedziso a₁ = 3 netsanangudzo ye S₁ (huwandu kubva pa term yekutanga kusvika ku term yekutanga).
y-m-60-07.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kuti Sₙ₋₁ inova chii kana ukaisa n=1 mu formula yemutsetse 1.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.line.3: Saka pa natural number n dzese, aₙ = 2n + 1.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 1 unoshanda kana n≥2 chete. S₀ haina kutsanangurwa, saka haigone kushandiswa kune n=1. Saka 'natural number n dzese' mumutsetse 4 ne a₁ = 3 mumutsetse 5 zvakaipa. Term yekutanga i a₁ = S₁ = 1 + 2 + 3 = 6. Kuverenga kwemitsetse 2 ne 3 (2n+1 kune n≥2) kwakarurama. Kusarudza mutsetse 1, mutsetse 4, kana mutsetse 5 chero upi kunobvumirwa.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.prompt: Sₙ = pn² + qn + r (p, q, r i ma integers, p≥1), S₃ = 21, uye term yekutanga a₁ = S₁ i 1 kana kupfuura. Muchiitiko ichi, wana mitengo miviri yakasiyana ye p apo mutengo unowanikwa nekuisa n=1 mu formula kubva ku aₙ = Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ (kune n≥2) unoenzana ne S₁ (ndiko kuti, zviitiko apo term yekutanga haidi kusimbiswa zvakaparadzana), uye uaise.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga zvakananga Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ ye pn² + qn + r uye uipfupise kuita expression mu n.
